blocks.text: SYDNEY — More than 100 million red crabs on Australia’s Christmas Island have begun their annual migration from the forest to the sea, conservationists said this week. The yearly march of the crabs on the remote territory in the Indian Ocean comes when the rainy season hits and the crustaceans move to the sea to breed.
